title: Commons muted text literals in the niche stylesheet use the AA-passing token
detail:
Literal #7C766F (4.10:1 on canvas) remains at site-niche.css:53-140 though the token was fixed in frequency.css. /accessibility claims contrast is met.

Commons muted text now uses the AA token var(--fq-text-muted) in site-niche.css

verify.note: Exits 0 once the repair has landed.
